params.name: embed
params.description: Available values for embed : addendum (to retrieve lodgingInformation, carRentalInformation, airItineraryInformation)

items.docs:
The API provides possibility to retrieve a list of transactions (original first presentments or fee collections received from the card schemes), based on certain criteria. 

To prevent overly broad searches, at least one of the following conditional search criteria must be provided :
•	PAN
•	PAN token
•	Transaction identifier
•	Acquirer reference number
•	Virtual Service Card Number
•	Card Identifier
•	Account Identifier
•	Related Transaction
